summary: The StudentRAITProvision system handles the management of RAIT provisioning for students within an educational institution. This includes inserting, editing, and deleting provisioning records and handling associated workflows through a web interface.
purpose: To manage the Resource Allocation and IT (RAIT) provisioning process for students, including adding, editing, and deleting provisioning entries related to students and associated agencies.

fields.name: StudentID
fields.description: Identifier for a student involved in RAIT provisioning.

fields.name: StaffID
fields.description: Identifier for a staff member associated with the RAIT provisioning.

fields.name: AgencyID
fields.description: Identifier for the agency associated with the RAIT provisioning.

actors.name: System Administrator
actors.role: Oversees and can make changes to all provisioning records.

actors.name: Receiving Coordinator
actors.role: Manages provisioning records related to receiving agencies.

workflows.name: RAIT Provisioning Management
steps: Edit or insert a new RAIT provisioning record through the UI.
Select or disable fields based on user permissions and session data.
Submit changes to update the system records.

business_rules: Only system administrators or users with specific roles can edit the unique ID of a provisioning record.
Provisioning records can only be edited by a receiving coordinator if the user's session is aligned with the agency.
validations: Ensure Page.IsValid before inserting or updating records.
Disable fields based on user roles and session information.
calculations: Determine the default agency ID based on user session or placement data.
conditions: Disable dropdowns if the session agency does not match the current target agency.
system_behavior: Setup JavaScript variables for UI interaction.
Redirect users upon record insertion or update.
dependencies: User session data for permissions and agency alignment.
External dropdown controls for agency selection.
exceptions: Cancel operations if the user session is not valid.
Redirect if necessary permissions are not met.
